Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，A location phrase should come before the action verb it modifies. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：装作祭拜，装作 is used before a verb phrase to express pretending to do an action. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟妈妈搬家：妈妈带着他搬家了，The mother is the person who takes the child when the family moves, so 带着 expresses the correct relationship; this single move is completed, so it also needs 了. [vocab list]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友：他和朋友，Use a pronoun for a recently mentioned character when no other possible referent has appeared. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子五岁的时候：他五岁的时候，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence of the same character. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]

items.reason: 地点短语应放在动词“玩”前面。
“装祭拜”搭配不完整，“装作祭拜”可以正确表示假装进行祭拜。
“跟妈妈搬家”本身正确，并不需要改成妈妈带着他搬家或强加“了”。
孟子刚在前一句出现，按该参考规则此处应使用“他”而非重复姓名。
孟子在紧邻的语境中已被提到，此处用“他五岁的时候”符合近距离重复时使用代词的规则。
